description: Na₂GdCl₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.26 Å. Gd is bonded to seven Cl atoms to form distorted edge-sharing GdCl₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Gd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.70-2.79 Å. There are four inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and one Gd atom to form distorted ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent ClNa₄Gd square pyramids, corners with five ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent ClNa₂Gd₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ClNa₄Gd square pyramids, edges with four equivalent ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent ClNa₂Gd₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Gd atoms to form distorted ClNa₂Gd₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent ClNa₄Gd square pyramids, corners with four ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramids, corners with six equivalent ClNa₂Gd₂ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ClNa₄Gd square pyramid, edges with four ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ClNa₂Gd₂ trigonal pyramid. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and one Gd atom to form ClNa₄Gd square pyramids that share corners with nine ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramids, corners with eight equivalent ClNa₂Gd₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ClNa₄Gd square pyramids, edges with three ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ClNa₂Gd₂ trigonal pyramids, and  a faceface with one ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramid. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and one Gd atom to form distorted ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent ClNa₄Gd square pyramids, corners with five ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent ClNa₂Gd₂ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ClNa₄Gd square pyramid, edges with four equivalent ClNa₄Gd trigonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent ClNa₂Gd₂ trigonal pyramids, and  a faceface with one ClNa₄Gd square pyramid.
